## Pull request overview

Adds a new deployment guide describing how to deploy ObjectStack apps to Vercel in two modes—MSW (static SPA) and Server (serverless/edge)—and wires it into the Guides navigation.

**Changes:**
- Added a new “Deploy to Vercel” guide covering MSW mode and server-mode options (Next.js + Edge/Hono).
- Registered the new guide in the Guides sidebar metadata (Operations section).
- Linked the guide from the Guides index Operations table.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `content/docs/guides/deployment-vercel.mdx` | New Vercel deployment guide with MSW + server/edge patterns, env vars, and checklists |
| `content/docs/guides/meta.json` | Adds `deployment-vercel` under the Operations section |
| `content/docs/guides/index.mdx` | Adds “Deploy to Vercel” link to the Operations table |

The comment says the catch-all dispatches based on the first segment “(data, meta, auth, etc.)”, but the `switch` only implements `data` and `meta`. Either expand the example to handle the other protocol segments (auth/graphql/storage/...) or adjust the wording so it matches what the code actually does.

Next.js App Router needs explicit exports for each HTTP method. `createRouteHandler` supports `PUT` (used for metadata writes), but this example only exports GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE, so PUT requests will return 405. Export `PUT` as well (and any other methods you intend to support).
```suggestion
export { handler as GET, handler as POST, handler as PUT, handler as PATCH, handler as DELETE };
```

This section says to use the `@objectstack/hono` adapter, but the package currently only exposes `objectStackMiddleware()` and does not provide a route handler/dispatcher integration. The example also doesn’t import anything from `@objectstack/hono`, so readers can’t actually follow the instruction as written. Either update the text to describe the manual `HttpDispatcher` approach, or update the example to use the adapter API (once it exists).

The Hono Edge example instantiates `HttpDispatcher`, but `HttpDispatcher` is marked `@deprecated` in `@objectstack/runtime` with guidance to use `createDispatcherPlugin()` instead and a note that it will be removed in v2. Publishing a deployment guide that depends on a deprecated API is likely to age poorly; consider switching the guide to the recommended non-deprecated approach, or explicitly label this option as legacy/temporary with a migration note.
